{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_63eaf8aaa8ee448a83f7dfdb","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# Normalized Event Schema\n2\t\n3\t## Overview\n4\t\n5\tThe normalized event schema is the harness-agnostic contract between event producers (adapters, detectors) and the Trail Boss daemon. All normalized events are submitted to the `/event/normalized` endpoint and share a common structure with a `type` discriminator.\n6\t\n7\tThis design isolates harness coupling to the adapter layer — the daemon consumes only normalized events and has no knowledge of harness-specific formats (Claude Code hooks, tmux detector, etc.).\n8\t\n9\t## Type Discriminator\n10\t\n11\tAll normalized events have a required `type` field that serves as a discriminated union discriminator:\n12\t\n13\t```typescript\n14\ttype NormalizedEvent = StuckEvent | UnstuckEvent | SessionRegistered | SessionEnded;\n15\t```\n16\t\n17\tType guards are used to narrow the type at runtime:\n18\t\n19\t```typescript\n20\tfunction isStuckEvent(event: unknown): event is StuckEvent {\n21\t  return (event as NormalizedEvent)?.type === \"stuck\";\n22\t}\n23\t```\n24\t\n25\t## Event Types\n26\t\n27\t### 1. StuckEvent\n28\t\n29\tA session became stuck and needs attention. This is the core event that adds a session to the queue.\n30\t\n31\t```typescript\n32\tinterface StuckEvent {\n33\t  type: \"stuck\";\n34\t  sessionId: string;\n35\t  paneId: string;\n36\t  cwd: string;\n37\t  transcriptPath: string;\n38\t  reason: \"stopped\" | \"permission\";\n39\t  message: string;\n40\t  timestamp: number; // Unix milliseconds\n41\t}\n42\t```\n43\t\n44\t**Required Fields:**\n45\t\n46\t| Field | Type | Validation |\n47\t|-------|------|------------|\n48\t| `type` | `\"stuck\"` | Must be exactly `\"stuck\"` |\n49\t| `sessionId` | `string` | Non-empty, unique identifier for the session |\n50\t| `paneId` | `string` | tmux pane ID (e.g., `%446`) or synthetic equivalent |\n51\t| `cwd` | `string` | Current working directory (empty string if unknown) |\n52\t| `transcriptPath` | `string` | Absolute path to transcript JSONL (empty string if unknown) |\n53\t| `reason` | `\"stopped\" \\| \"permission\"` | Must be exactly `\"stopped\"` or `\"permission\"` |\n54\t| `message` | `string` | Context message (e.g., last assistant message, tool name) |\n55\t| `timestamp` | `number` | Unix milliseconds, must be > 0 |\n56\t\n57\t**Field Semantics:**\n58\t\n59\t- `sessionId`: Unique identifier for the session. For Claude Code, this is the harness session ID. For tmux detector, this is synthetic: `tmux-{paneId}-{timestamp}`.\n60\t- `paneId`: tmux pane identifier (e.g., `%446`). Used for navigation to the stuck session.\n61\t- `cwd`: Working directory for context display. May be empty for synthetic sessions.\n62\t- `transcriptPath`: Path to the session's transcript JSONL for reconciliation. May be empty for synthetic sessions (tmux detector has no transcript).\n63\t- `reason`: Why the session is stuck. `\"stopped\"` = session hit a Stop hook. `\"permission\"` = session is waiting at a permission prompt. Tmux detector always uses `\"stopped\"` (cannot distinguish).\n64\t- `message`: Human-readable context. For stopped sessions, this is the last assistant message. For permission sessions, this is the tool name and input. For tmux detector, this is the last line of output.\n65\t- `timestamp`: When the stuck event occurred. Used for queue ordering and staleness detection.\n66\t\n67\t**Examples:**\n68\t\n69\t```typescript\n70\t// From Claude Code hooks (stopped)\n71\t{\n72\t  type: \"stuck\",\n73\t  sessionId: \"claude-42-abc123\",\n74\t  paneId: \"%446\",\n75\t  cwd: \"/home/coding/project\",\n76\t  transcriptPath: \"/home/coding/.claude/sessions/abc123/transcript.jsonl\",\n77\t  reason: \"stopped\",\n78\t  message: \"The user has not responded. Waiting for input.\",\n79\t  timestamp: 1735689600000\n80\t}\n81\t\n82\t// From Claude Code hooks (permission)\n83\t{\n84\t  type: \"stuck\",\n85\t  sessionId: \"claude-42-def456\",\n86\t  paneId: \"%447\",\n87\t  cwd: \"/home/coding/project\",\n88\t  transcriptPath: \"/home/coding/.claude/sessions/def456/transcript.jsonl\",\n89\t  reason: \"permission\",\n90\t  message: \"Tool: Bash | Command: npm install\",\n91\t  timestamp: 1735689605000\n92\t}\n93\t\n94\t// From tmux detector\n95\t{\n96\t  type: \"stuck\",\n97\t  sessionId: \"tmux-%446-1735689600000\",\n98\t  paneId: \"%446\",\n99\t  cwd: \"/home/coding/project\",\n100\t  transcriptPath: \"\",\n101\t  reason: \"stopped\",\n102\t  message: \"Quiet at prompt: $ \",\n103\t  timestamp: 1735689600000\n104\t}\n105\t```\n106\t\n107\t---\n108\t\n109\t### 2. UnstuckEvent\n110\t\n111\tA session progressed and is no longer stuck. This removes the session from the queue.\n112\t\n113\t```typescript\n114\tinterface UnstuckEvent {\n115\t  type: \"unstuck\";\n116\t  sessionId: string;\n117\t  timestamp: number; // Unix milliseconds\n118\t}\n119\t```\n120\t\n121\t**Required Fields:**\n122\t\n123\t| Field | Type | Validation |\n124\t|-------|------|------------|\n125\t| `type` | `\"unstuck\"` | Must be exactly `\"unstuck\"` |\n126\t| `sessionId` | `string` | Must match an existing session in the queue |\n127\t| `timestamp` | `number` | Unix milliseconds, must be > 0 |\n128\t\n129\t**Field Semantics:**\n130\t\n131\t- `sessionId`: Must match a currently stuck session. If the session is not in the queue, the event is ignored (idempotent).\n132\t- `timestamp`: When the unstuck event occurred. Used for logging and metrics.\n133\t\n134\t**Examples:**\n135\t\n136\t```typescript\n137\t{\n138\t  type: \"unstuck\",\n139\t  sessionId: \"claude-42-abc123\",\n140\t  timestamp: 1735689660000\n141\t}\n142\t```\n143\t\n144\t---\n145\t\n146\t### 3. SessionRegistered\n147\t\n148\tA new session has been registered for monitoring. This initializes session tracking.\n149\t\n150\t```typescript\n151\tinterface SessionRegistered {\n152\t  type: \"registered\";\n153\t  sessionId: string;\n154\t  paneId: string;\n155\t  cwd: string;\n156\t  transcriptPath: string;\n157\t  timestamp: number; // Unix milliseconds\n158\t}\n159\t```\n160\t\n161\t**Required Fields:**\n162\t\n163\t| Field | Type | Validation |\n164\t|-------|------|------------|\n165\t| `type` | `\"registered\"` | Must be exactly `\"registered\"` |\n166\t| `sessionId` | `string` | Non-empty, unique identifier for the session |\n167\t| `paneId` | `string` | tmux pane ID (e.g., `%446`) or synthetic equivalent |\n168\t| `cwd` | `string` | Current working directory (empty string if unknown) |\n169\t| `transcriptPath` | `string` | Absolute path to transcript JSONL (empty string if unknown) |\n170\t| `timestamp` | `number` | Unix milliseconds, must be > 0 |\n171\t\n172\t**Field Semantics:**\n173\t\n174\t- `sessionId`: Unique identifier for the session. Used to associate subsequent stuck/unstuck events with this registration.\n175\t- `paneId`: tmux pane identifier for navigation.\n176\t- `cwd`: Working directory for context display.\n177\t- `transcriptPath`: Path to the session's transcript JSONL for reconciliation.\n178\t- `timestamp`: When the session was registered.\n179\t\n180\t**Examples:**\n181\t\n182\t```typescript\n183\t// From Claude Code adapter\n184\t{\n185\t  type: \"registered\",\n186\t  sessionId: \"claude-42-abc123\",\n187\t  paneId: \"%446\",\n188\t  cwd: \"/home/coding/project\",\n189\t  transcriptPath: \"/home/coding/.claude/sessions/abc123/transcript.jsonl\",\n190\t  timestamp: 1735689600000\n191\t}\n192\t\n193\t// From tmux detector\n194\t{\n195\t  type: \"registered\",\n196\t  sessionId: \"tmux-%446-1735689600000\",\n197\t  paneId: \"%446\",\n198\t  cwd: \"/home/coding/project\",\n199\t  transcriptPath: \"\",\n200\t  timestamp: 1735689600000\n201\t}\n202\t```\n203\t\n204\t---\n205\t\n206\t### 4. SessionEnded\n207\t\n208\tA session has terminated. This removes the session from tracking and emits an unstuck event if the session was stuck.\n209\t\n210\t```typescript\n211\tinterface SessionEnded {\n212\t  type: \"ended\";\n213\t  sessionId: string;\n214\t  timestamp: number; // Unix milliseconds\n215\t}\n216\t```\n217\t\n218\t**Required Fields:**\n219\t\n220\t| Field | Type | Validation |\n221\t|-------|------|------------|\n222\t| `type` | `\"ended\"` | Must be exactly `\"ended\"` |\n223\t| `sessionId` | `string` | Must match a tracked session |\n224\t| `timestamp` | `number` | Unix milliseconds, must be > 0 |\n225\t\n226\t**Field Semantics:**\n227\t\n228\t- `sessionId`: Must match a currently tracked session. If the session is not tracked, the event is ignored (idempotent).\n229\t- `timestamp`: When the session ended.\n230\t\n231\t**Examples:**\n232\t\n233\t```typescript\n234\t{\n235\t  type: \"ended\",\n236\t  sessionId: \"claude-42-abc123\",\n237\t  timestamp: 1735689660000\n238\t}\n239\t```\n240\t\n241\t---\n242\t\n243\t## Validation Rules\n244\t\n245\t### Type-Level Validation\n246\t\n247\t1. **Type field must be a valid literal**: `\"stuck\" | \"unstuck\" | \"registered\" | \"ended\"`\n248\t2. **Timestamp must be positive**: `timestamp > 0`\n249\t3. **String fields must be non-empty** where specified (sessionId, paneId)\n250\t4. **Enum fields must match exact values**: `reason` must be `\"stopped\" | \"permission\"`\n251\t\n252\t### Business Logic Validation\n253\t\n254\t1. **Session ID consistency**: All events for the same session must use the same `sessionId`\n255\t2. **Pane ID consistency**: `paneId` should be consistent across registered/stuck events for the same session\n256\t3. **Event ordering**: `registered` → `stuck` → `unstuck` → `ended` (unstuck may repeat, ended is terminal)\n257\t4. **Idempotency**: Duplicate events are handled gracefully:\n258\t   - Duplicate `stuck`: Updates the queue entry (new timestamp, message)\n259\t   - Duplicate `unstuck`: No-op if session not in queue\n260\t   - Duplicate `registered`: Updates pane/cwd/transcript metadata\n261\t   - Duplicate `ended`: No-op if session not tracked\n262\t\n263\t### Type-Specific Rules\n264\t\n265\t#### StuckEvent\n266\t\n267\t- `paneId` is required for navigation (cannot be empty)\n268\t- `reason` must be `\"stopped\"` or `\"permission\"` (no other values)\n269\t- `message` should be non-empty (used for queue display)\n270\t- `cwd` may be empty for synthetic sessions\n271\t- `transcriptPath` may be empty for synthetic sessions\n272\t\n273\t#### UnstuckEvent\n274\t\n275\t- `sessionId` must match a currently stuck session (ignored otherwise)\n276\t- Only `sessionId` and `timestamp` are required (minimal payload)\n277\t\n278\t#### SessionRegistered\n279\t\n280\t- `paneId` is required (cannot be empty)\n281\t- `cwd` may be empty\n282\t- `transcriptPath` may be empty\n283\t\n284\t#### SessionEnded\n285\t\n286\t- `sessionId` must match a tracked session (ignored otherwise)\n287\t- Only `sessionId` and `timestamp` are required (minimal payload)\n288\t\n289\t## Error Handling\n290\t\n291\t### Invalid Events\n292\t\n293\tThe daemon `/event/normalized` endpoint returns `400 Bad Request` for:\n294\t\n295\t1. Missing required fields\n296\t2. Invalid type literals (e.g., `type: \"stuckk\"`)\n297\t3. Invalid enum values (e.g., `reason: \"blocked\"`)\n298\t4. Invalid timestamps (e.g., `timestamp: -1` or `timestamp: \"2024-01-01\"`)\n299\t5. All normalized events are submitted to the `/event/normalized` endpoint and share a common structure with a `type` discriminator.\n\nThis design isolates harness coupling to the adapter layer — the daemon consumes only normalized events and has no knowledge of harness-specific formats (Claude Code hooks, tmux detector, etc.).\n\n## Type Discriminator\n\nAll normalized events have a required `type` field that serves as a discriminated union discriminator:\n\n```typescript\ntype NormalizedEvent = StuckEvent | UnstuckEvent | SessionRegistered | SessionEnded;\n```\n\nType guards are used to narrow the type at runtime:\n\n```typescript\nfunction isStuckEvent(event: unknown): event is StuckEvent {\n  return (event as NormalizedEvent)?.type === \"stuck\";\n}\n```\n\n## Event Types\n\n### 1. StuckEvent\n\nA session became stuck and needs attention. This is the core event that adds a session to the queue.\n\n```typescript\ninterface StuckEvent {\n  type: \"stuck\";\n  sessionId: string;\n  paneId: string;\n  cwd: string;\n  transcriptPath: string;\n  reason: \"stopped\" | \"permission\";\n  message: string;\n  timestamp: number; // Unix milliseconds\n}\n```\n\n**Required Fields:**\n\n| Field | Type | Validation |\n|-------|------|------------|\n| `type` | `\"stuck\"` | Must be exactly `\"stuck\"` |\n| `sessionId` | `string` | Non-empty, unique identifier for the session |\n| `paneId` | `string` | tmux pane ID (e.g., `%446`) or synthetic equivalent |\n| `cwd` | `string` | Current working directory (empty string if unknown) |\n| `transcriptPath` | `string` | Absolute path to transcript JSONL (empty string if unknown) |\n| `reason` | `\"stopped\" \\| \"permission\"` | Must be exactly `\"stopped\"` or `\"permission\"` |\n| `message` | `string` | Context message (e.g., last assistant message, tool name) |\n| `timestamp` | `number` | Unix milliseconds, must be > 0 |\n\n**Field Semantics:**\n\n- `sessionId`: Unique identifier for the session. For Claude Code, this is the harness session ID. For tmux detector, this is synthetic: `tmux-{paneId}-{timestamp}`.\n- `paneId`: tmux pane identifier (e.g., `%446`). Used for navigation to the stuck session.\n- `cwd`: Working directory for context display. May be empty for synthetic sessions.\n- `transcriptPath`: Path to the session's transcript JSONL for reconciliation. May be empty for synthetic sessions (tmux detector has no transcript).\n- `reason`: Why the session is stuck. `\"stopped\"` = session hit a Stop hook. `\"permission\"` = session is waiting at a permission prompt. Tmux detector always uses `\"stopped\"` (cannot distinguish).\n- `message`: Human-readable context. For stopped sessions, this is the last assistant message. For permission sessions, this is the tool name and input. For tmux detector, this is the last line of output.\n- `timestamp`: When the stuck event occurred. Used for queue ordering and staleness detection.\n\n**Examples:**\n\n```typescript\n// From Claude Code hooks (stopped)\n{\n  type: \"stuck\",\n  sessionId: \"claude-42-abc123\",\n  paneId: \"%446\",\n  cwd: \"/home/coding/project\",\n  transcriptPath: \"/home/coding/.claude/sessions/abc123/transcript.jsonl\",\n  reason: \"stopped\",\n  message: \"The user has not responded. Waiting for input.\",\n  timestamp: 1735689600000\n}\n\n// From Claude Code hooks (permission)\n{\n  type: \"stuck\",\n  sessionId: \"claude-42-def456\",\n  paneId: \"%447\",\n  cwd: \"/home/coding/project\",\n  transcriptPath: \"/home/coding/.claude/sessions/def456/transcript.jsonl\",\n  reason: \"permission\",\n  message: \"Tool: Bash | Command: npm install\",\n  timestamp: 1735689605000\n}\n\n// From tmux detector\n{\n  type: \"stuck\",\n  sessionId: \"tmux-%446-1735689600000\",\n  paneId: \"%446\",\n  cwd: \"/home/coding/project\",\n  transcriptPath: \"\",\n  reason: \"stopped\",\n  message: \"Quiet at prompt: $ \",\n  timestamp: 1735689600000\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2. UnstuckEvent\n\nA session progressed and is no longer stuck. This removes the session from the queue.\n\n```typescript\ninterface UnstuckEvent {\n  type: \"unstuck\";\n  sessionId: string;\n  timestamp: number; // Unix milliseconds\n}\n```\n\n**Required Fields:**\n\n| Field | Type | Validation |\n|-------|------|------------|\n| `type` | `\"unstuck\"` | Must be exactly `\"unstuck\"` |\n| `sessionId` | `string` | Must match an existing session in the queue |\n| `timestamp` | `number` | Unix milliseconds, must be > 0 |\n\n**Field Semantics:**\n\n- `sessionId`: Must match a currently stuck session. If the session is not in the queue, the event is ignored (idempotent).\n- `timestamp`: When the unstuck event occurred. Used for logging and metrics.\n\n**Examples:**\n\n```typescript\n{\n  type: \"unstuck\",\n  sessionId: \"claude-42-abc123\",\n  timestamp: 1735689660000\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### 3. SessionRegistered\n\nA new session has been registered for monitoring. This initializes session tracking.\n\n```typescript\ninterface SessionRegistered {\n  type: \"registered\";\n  sessionId: string;\n  paneId: string;\n  cwd: string;\n  transcriptPath: string;\n  timestamp: number; // Unix milliseconds\n}\n```\n\n**Required Fields:**\n\n| Field | Type | Validation |\n|-------|------|------------|\n| `type` | `\"registered\"` | Must be exactly `\"registered\"` |\n| `sessionId` | `string` | Non-empty, unique identifier for the session |\n| `paneId` | `string` | tmux pane ID (e.g., `%446`) or synthetic equivalent |\n| `cwd` | `string` | Current working directory (empty string if unknown) |\n| `transcriptPath` | `string` | Absolute path to transcript JSONL (empty string if unknown) |\n| `timestamp` | `number` | Unix milliseconds, must be > 0 |\n\n**Field Semantics:**\n\n- `sessionId`: Unique identifier for the session. Used to associate subsequent stuck/unstuck events with this registration.\n- `paneId`: tmux pane identifier for navigation.\n- `cwd`: Working directory for context display.\n- `transcriptPath`: Path to the session's transcript JSONL for reconciliation.\n- `timestamp`: When the session was registered.\n\n**Examples:**\n\n```typescript\n// From Claude Code adapter\n{\n  type: \"registered\",\n  sessionId: \"claude-42-abc123\",\n  paneId: \"%446\",\n  cwd: \"/home/coding/project\",\n  transcriptPath: \"/home/coding/.claude/sessions/abc123/transcript.jsonl\",\n  timestamp: 1735689600000\n}\n\n// From tmux detector\n{\n  type: \"registered\",\n  sessionId: \"tmux-%446-1735689600000\",\n  paneId: \"%446\",\n  cwd: \"/home/coding/project\",\n  transcriptPath: \"\",\n  timestamp: 1735689600000\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### 4. SessionEnded\n\nA session has terminated. This removes the session from tracking and emits an unstuck event if the session was stuck.\n\n```typescript\ninterface SessionEnded {\n  type: \"ended\";\n  sessionId: string;\n  timestamp: number; // Unix milliseconds\n}\n```\n\n**Required Fields:**\n\n| Field | Type | Validation |\n|-------|------|------------|\n| `type` | `\"ended\"` | Must be exactly `\"ended\"` |\n| `sessionId` | `string` | Must match a tracked session |\n| `timestamp` | `number` | Unix milliseconds, must be > 0 |\n\n**Field Semantics:**\n\n- `sessionId`: Must match a currently tracked session. If the session is not tracked, the event is ignored (idempotent).\n- `timestamp`: When the session ended.\n\n**Examples:**\n\n```typescript\n{\n  type: \"ended\",\n  sessionId: \"claude-42-abc123\",\n  timestamp: 1735689660000\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Validation Rules\n\n### Type-Level Validation\n\n1. **Type field must be a valid literal**: `\"stuck\" | \"unstuck\" | \"registered\" | \"ended\"`\n2. **Timestamp must be positive**: `timestamp > 0`\n3. **String fields must be non-empty** where specified (sessionId, paneId)\n4. **Enum fields must match exact values**: `reason` must be `\"stopped\" | \"permission\"`\n\n### Business Logic Validation\n\n1. **Session ID consistency**: All events for the same session must use the same `sessionId`\n2. **Pane ID consistency**: `paneId` should be consistent across registered/stuck events for the same session\n3. **Event ordering**: `registered` → `stuck` → `unstuck` → `ended` (unstuck may repeat, ended is terminal)\n4. **Idempotency**: Duplicate events are handled gracefully:\n   - Duplicate `stuck`: Updates the queue entry (new timestamp, message)\n   - Duplicate `unstuck`: No-op if session not in queue\n   - Duplicate `registered`: Updates pane/cwd/transcript metadata\n   - Duplicate `ended`: No-op if session not tracked\n\n### Type-Specific Rules\n\n#### StuckEvent\n\n- `paneId` is required for navigation (cannot be empty)\n- `reason` must be `\"stopped\"` or `\"permission\"` (no other values)\n- `message` should be non-empty (used for queue display)\n- `cwd` may be empty for synthetic sessions\n- `transcriptPath` may be empty for synthetic sessions\n\n#### UnstuckEvent\n\n- `sessionId` must match a currently stuck session (ignored otherwise)\n- Only `sessionId` and `timestamp` are required (minimal payload)\n\n#### SessionRegistered\n\n- `paneId` is required (cannot be empty)\n- `cwd` may be empty\n- `transcriptPath` may be empty\n\n#### SessionEnded\n\n- `sessionId` must match a tracked session (ignored otherwise)\n- Only `sessionId` and `timestamp` are required (minimal payload)\n\n## Error Handling\n\n### Invalid Events\n\nThe daemon `/event/normalized` endpoint returns `400 Bad Request` for:\n\n1. Missing required fields\n2. Invalid type literals (e.g., `type: \"stuckk\"`)\n3. Invalid enum values (e.g., `reason: \"blocked\"`)\n4. Invalid timestamps (e.g., `timestamp: -1` or `timestamp: \"2024-01-01\"`)\n5. Malformed JSON\n\nError response format:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"error\": \"Invalid event: missing required field 'sessionId'\"\n}\n```\n\n### Out-of-Order Events\n\nThe daemon handles out-of-order events gracefully:\n\n1. **Unstuck before stuck**: Ignored (session not in queue)\n2. **Ended before registered**: Ignored (session not tracked)\n3. **Stuck after ended**: Ignored (session no longer tracked)\n\n### Unknown Event Types\n\nEvents with unknown `type` values are rejected with `400 Bad Request`:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"error\": \"Invalid event: unknown type 'paused'\"\n}\n```\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n### Submitting to the Daemon\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4000/event/normalized \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\n    \"type\": \"stuck\",\n    \"sessionId\": \"claude-42-abc123\",\n    \"paneId\": \"%446\",\n    \"cwd\": \"/home/coding/project\",\n    \"transcriptPath\": \"/home/coding/.claude/sessions/abc123/transcript.jsonl\",\n    \"reason\": \"stopped\",\n    \"message\": \"The user has not responded. Waiting for input.\",\n    \"timestamp\": 1735689600000\n  }'\n```\n\n### Type Guards in TypeScript\n\n```typescript\nfunction handleEvent(event: unknown): void {\n  if (isStuckEvent(event)) {\n    // TypeScript knows event is StuckEvent\n    addToQueue(event);\n  } else if (isUnstuckEvent(event)) {\n    // TypeScript knows event is UnstuckEvent\n    removeFromQueue(event.sessionId);\n  } else if (isSessionRegistered(event)) {\n    // TypeScript knows event is SessionRegistered\n    trackSession(event);\n  } else if (isSessionEnded(event)) {\n    // TypeScript knows event is SessionEnded\n    untrackSession(event.sessionId);\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Implementation Status\n\n✅ **Complete** — The normalized event schema is implemented in:\n\n- `daemon/types.ts` — TypeScript type definitions\n- `daemon/index.ts` — `/event/normalized` endpoint handler (lines 99-170)\n- `daemon/tmux-detector.ts` — Emits normalized events to `/event/normalized`\n- `daemon/claude-adapter.ts` — Emits normalized events to `/event/normalized`\n\n## See Also\n\n- `daemon/types.ts` — Source type definitions\n- `docs/notes/decisions.md` — Design rationale for normalized event API\n- `daemon/index.ts` — Endpoint implementation\n","numLines":380,"startLine":1,"totalLines":380}}}

It requires:\n- `X-Tmux-Pane` header (hook-specific environment capture)\n- `HookEvent` payload format (Claude Code hook schema)\n- `adaptHookEvent()` adapter to normalize\n\nA dedicated `/event/normalized` endpoint separates **harness-specific detection** from **harness-agnostic core processing**. This aligns with the plan's stated architecture (see `docs/plan/plan.md` \"Layering: harness-coupled detection vs. harness-agnostic core\").\n\n### 2. Adapter Simplicity\nOption 1 requires adapters to emit clean, simple JSON matching the domain model:\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"stuck\",\n  \"sessionId\": \"tmux-%12-1234567890\",\n  \"paneId\": \"%12\",\n  \"cwd\": \"/home/coding/project\",\n  \"transcriptPath\": \"\",\n  \"reason\": \"stopped\",\n  \"message\": \"waiting for input\",\n  \"timestamp\": 1719987600000\n}\n```\n\nOption 2 would require adapters to synthesize Claude hook payloads:\n```json\n{\n  \"session_id\": \"tmux-%12-1234567890\",\n  \"transcript_path\": \"\",\n  \"cwd\": \"/home/coding/project\",\n  \"hook_event_name\": \"Stop\",\n  \"last_assistant_message\": \"waiting for input\",\n  \"stop_hook_active\": true\n}\n```\nPlus an `X-Tmux-Pane` header. This is **leaky abstraction** — the adapter needs to know Claude's hook schema.\n\n### 3. Future-Proofing for Multiple Harnesses\nThe plan explicitly states: *\"Adapters produce that normalized event however they can\"*. With Option 1, each harness implements its adapter once and emits normalized events. The daemon doesn't need a per-harness adapter chain.\n\nWith Option 2, every new harness would need:\n1. Adapter to wrap events in Claude hook format (which doesn't fit non-Claude harnesses)\n2. Server-side adapter to unwrap Claude format back to normalized\n\nThis is an unnecessary round-trip through a representation that's Claude-specific.\n\n### 4. Validation & Error Clarity\nWith `/event/normalized`, the daemon validates normalized event schemas directly. Errors are clear: \"missing field `reason`\" vs. \"invalid HookEvent format → unwrap → validation\".\n\n### 5. Testability\nNormalized events are easier to test in isolation:\n```bash\n# Direct test\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:4000/event/normalized -d '{\n  \"type\": \"stuck\",\n  \"sessionId\": \"test-123\",\n  \"paneId\": \"%99\",\n  \"cwd\": \"/tmp\",\n  \"transcriptPath\": \"\",\n  \"reason\": \"stopped\",\n  \"message\": \"test\",\n  \"timestamp\": 1719987600000\n}'\n```\n\nWith Option 2, every test needs to synthesize Claude hook payloads.\n\n## Implementation Status\n\n**COMPLETE** — The `/event/normalized` endpoint is implemented in `daemon/index.ts` (lines 99-170).\n\n### Endpoint Details\n\n- **Path:** `/event/normalized`\n- **Method:** `POST`\n- **Content-Type:** `application/json`\n- **Authentication:** None (localhost-only daemon)\n- **Request Body:** Normalized event object (see `docs/notes/normalized-event-contract.md`)\n- **Response:** `{\"ok\": true}` on success\n\n### Accepted Event Types\n\n| Type | Purpose | Required Fields |\n|------|---------|-----------------|\n| `stuck` | Session blocked on user input | `type`, `sessionId`, `paneId`, `cwd`, `transcriptPath`, `reason`, `message`, `timestamp` |\n| `unstuck` | Session resumed | `type`, `sessionId`, `timestamp` |\n| `registered` | New session started | `type`, `sessionId`, `paneId`, `cwd`, `transcriptPath`, `timestamp` |\n| `ended` | Session terminated | `type`, `sessionId`, `timestamp` |\n\nFull event schema documented in `docs/notes/normalized-event-contract.md`.\n\n## How Tmux Detector Submits Events\n\nThe tmux detector (`daemon/tmux-detector.ts`) uses this endpoint:\n\n```typescript\nconst DAEMON_URL = \"http://127.0.0.1:4000/event/normalized\";\n\nasync function emitEvent(event: NormalizedEvent): Promise<boolean> {\n  const response = await fetch(DAEMON_URL, {\n    method: \"POST\",\n    headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n    body: JSON.stringify(event),\n  });\n  return response.ok;\n}\n```\n\n### Emitted Events\n\n| TypeScript interfaces are defined in **[daemon/types.ts](../../daemon/types.ts)**.\n\n## Event Type Discriminator\n\nAll normalized events use a `type` field as a discriminated union:\n\n```typescript\ntype NormalizedEvent = StuckEvent | UnstuckEvent | SessionRegistered | SessionEnded;\n```\n\n## StuckEvent\n\nSession became stuck and needs attention. This adds the session to the queue.\n\n```typescript\ninterface StuckEvent {\n  type: \"stuck\";\n  sessionId: string;\n  paneId: string;\n  cwd: string;\n  transcriptPath: string;\n  reason: \"stopped\" | \"permission\";\n  message: string;\n  timestamp: number; // Unix milliseconds\n}\n```\n\n### Required Fields\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|-------|------|-------------|\n| `type` | `\"stuck\"` | Literal discriminator |\n| `sessionId` | `string` | Unique session identifier (synthetic for tmux: `tmux-{paneId}-{timestamp}`) |\n| `paneId` | `string` | tmux pane ID (e.g., `%446`) |\n| `cwd` | `string` | Current working directory |\n| `transcriptPath` | `string` | Path to transcript (empty string for tmux detector) |\n| `reason` | `\"stopped\" \\| \"permission\"` | Why stuck (tmux detector always uses `\"stopped\"`) |\n| `message` | `string` | Context (last line of output) |\n| `timestamp` | `number` | Unix milliseconds |\n\n### Tmux Detector Example\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"stuck\",\n  \"sessionId\": \"tmux-%446-1735689600000\",\n  \"paneId\": \"%446\",\n  \"cwd\": \"/home/coding/trail-boss\",\n  \"transcriptPath\": \"\",\n  \"reason\": \"stopped\",\n  \"message\": \"Quiet at prompt: $ \",\n  \"timestamp\": 1735689600000\n}\n```\n\n## UnstuckEvent\n\nSession resumed and is no longer stuck. This removes the session from the queue.\n\n```typescript\ninterface UnstuckEvent {\n  type: \"unstuck\";\n  sessionId: string;\n  timestamp: number; // Unix milliseconds\n}\n```\n\n### Required Fields\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|-------|------|-------------|\n| `type` | `\"unstuck\"` | Literal discriminator |\n| `sessionId` | `string` | Must match a stuck session in queue |\n| `timestamp` | `number` | Unix milliseconds |\n\n### Tmux Detector Example\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"unstuck\",\n  \"sessionId\": \"tmux-%446-1735689600000\",\n  \"timestamp\": 1735689660000\n}\n```\n\n## SessionRegistered\n\nNew session discovered for monitoring. Initializes session tracking.\n\n```typescript\ninterface SessionRegistered {\n  type: \"registered\";\n  sessionId: string;\n  paneId: string;\n  cwd: string;\n  transcriptPath: string;\n  timestamp: number;\n}\n```\n\n### Tmux Detector Example\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"registered\",\n  \"sessionId\": \"tmux-%446-1735689600000\",\n  \"paneId\": \"%446\",\n  \"cwd\": \"/home/coding/trail-boss\",\n  \"transcriptPath\": \"\",\n  \"timestamp\": 1735689600000\n}\n```\n\n## SessionEnded\n\nSession terminated. Removes session from tracking and emits unstuck if stuck.\n\n```typescript\ninterface SessionEnded {\n  type: \"ended\";\n  sessionId: string;\n  timestamp: number;\n}\n```\n\n### Tmux Detector Example\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"ended\",\n  \"sessionId\": \"tmux-%446-1735689600000\",\n  \"timestamp\": 1735689720000\n}\n```\n\n## Validation Rules\n\n### Type-Level\n\n1. `type` must be exactly `\"stuck\"`, `\"unstuck\"`, `\"registered\"`, or `\"ended\"`\n2. `timestamp` must be a positive number (Unix milliseconds)\n3. `sessionId` and `paneId` must be non-empty strings\n4. `reason` must be exactly `\"stopped\"` or `\"permission\"`\n\n### Business Logic\n\n1. **Session ID consistency**: All events for a session use the same `sessionId`\n2. **Pane ID consistency**: `paneId` should be consistent across events\n3. **Event ordering**: `registered` → `stuck` → `unstuck` → `ended`\n4. **Idempotency**: Duplicate events are handled gracefully\n\n## Submission Endpoint\n\n```bash\nPOST http://127.0.0.1:4000/event/normalized\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\n  \"type\": \"stuck\",\n  \"sessionId\": \"tmux-%446-1735689600000\",\n  \"paneId\": \"%446\",\n  \"cwd\": \"/home/coding/trail-boss\",\n  \"transcriptPath\": \"\",\n  \"reason\": \"stopped\",\n  \"message\": \"Quiet at prompt: $ \",\n  \"timestamp\": 1735689600000\n}\n```\n\nResponse: `{\"ok\": true}` on success.\n\n## Tmux Detector Specifics\n\n### Session ID Format\n\nThe tmux detector uses synthetic session IDs:\n\n```\ntmux-{paneId}-{discovery_timestamp}\n```\n\nExample: `tmux-%446-1735689600000`\n\n### Reason Field\n\nThe tmux detector **always uses `\"stopped\"`** for the `reason` field. Removes session from tracking and emits unstuck if stuck.\n\n```typescript\ninterface SessionEnded {\n  type: \"ended\";\n  sessionId: string;\n  timestamp: number;\n}\n```\n\n### Tmux Detector Example\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"ended\",\n  \"sessionId\": \"tmux-%446-1735689600000\",\n  \"timestamp\": 1735689720000\n}\n```\n\n## Validation Rules\n\n### Type-Level\n\n1. `type` must be exactly `\"stuck\"`, `\"unstuck\"`, `\"registered\"`, or `\"ended\"`\n2. `timestamp` must be a positive number (Unix milliseconds)\n3. `sessionId` and `paneId` must be non-empty strings\n4. `reason` must be exactly `\"stopped\"` or `\"permission\"`\n\n### Business Logic\n\n1. **Session ID consistency**: All events for a session use the same `sessionId`\n2. **Pane ID consistency**: `paneId` should be consistent across events\n3. **Event ordering**: `registered` → `stuck` → `unstuck` → `ended`\n4. **Idempotency**: Duplicate events are handled gracefully\n\n## Submission Endpoint\n\n```bash\nPOST http://127.0.0.1:4000/event/normalized\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\n  \"type\": \"stuck\",\n  \"sessionId\": \"tmux-%446-1735689600000\",\n  \"paneId\": \"%446\",\n  \"cwd\": \"/home/coding/trail-boss\",\n  \"transcriptPath\": \"\",\n  \"reason\": \"stopped\",\n  \"message\": \"Quiet at prompt: $ \",\n  \"timestamp\": 1735689600000\n}\n```\n\nResponse: `{\"ok\": true}` on success.\n\n## Tmux Detector Specifics\n\n### Session ID Format\n\nThe tmux detector uses synthetic session IDs:\n\n```\ntmux-{paneId}-{discovery_timestamp}\n```\n\nExample: `tmux-%446-1735689600000`\n\n### Reason Field\n\nThe tmux detector **always uses `\"stopped\"`** for the `reason` field. It cannot distinguish between `stopped` and `permission` reasons since it only observes output state, not hook internals.\n\n### Transcript Path\n\nThe tmux detector always sets `transcriptPath` to `\"\"` (empty string) since there is no Claude Code transcript for tmux sessions.\n\n## Consistency with daemon/types.ts\n\nThis schema is consistent with the TypeScript interfaces in `daemon/types.ts`:\n\n- ✅ `StuckEvent` interface (lines 65-74)\n- ✅ `UnstuckEvent` interface (lines 89-93)\n- ✅ `SessionRegistered` interface (lines 111-118)\n- ✅ `SessionEnded` interface (lines 134-138)\n\n## Related Documentation\n\n- **Full schema:** [docs/notes/normalized-event-schema.md](../notes/normalized-event-schema.md)\n- **TypeScript definitions:** [daemon/types.ts](../../daemon/types.ts)\n- **API decision:** [docs/notes/tb-2tc5-api-design-decision.md](../notes/tb-2tc5-api-design-decision.md)\n- **Endpoint implementation:** [daemon/index.ts](../../daemon/index.ts) (lines 99-170)\n\n## Implementation Status\n\n✅ **Complete** — The normalized event schema is implemented and documented:\n\n- TypeScript types in `daemon/types.ts`\n- Endpoint `/event/normalized` in `daemon/index.ts`\n- Full schema documentation in `docs/notes/normalized-event-schema.md`\n- Tmux detector emits normalized events (see `daemon/tmux-adapter.ts`)\n\n---\n\n**Bead:** tb-1fk8\n**Date:** 2026-07-02\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}
